name: restdb.io
line: NoSQL document database with generated APIs, media storage, and codehooks.

free.text: 2,500 records, 500 calls/day, 100MB media; no idle pause or deletion rule

cells.regions: Norway processing stated; managed DB region choice unknown
cells.selfhost: No, hosted service; can connect your own MongoDB

sql.math: The likely base is the Standard plan at $29. The total adds unknown transfer and storage fit costs, and a 1 GB data allowance is not confirmed.
The Standard $29 subscription stays due while idle. Whether the kept data fits, and any add-on costs, are unknown.

files.math: 100 GB is more than Premium's 50 GB media allowance. No rate for extra storage, and no supported single-database total, is published.

jobs.math: Standard includes Codehooks & Jobs. But the rate for 10,000 worker runs, whether the run time fits, how many run at once, and the full total are unknown.
